text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"At the end of the journey, I saw a streak 
of gold."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"'A long, eternal... light that stretches 
far, far into the distance—'"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Let's chase after it and set off on our 
next journey."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Is that Big Sis's—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......The words Stay Gold left behind.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A parting gift deeply etched into the 
hearts of her and everyone who loved her 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Now, having come full circle—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...brought you and me together like this.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that... I can't help 
but feel a sense of fate.

The challenge of the Twinkle Series 
alongside Dream Journey. The day it all 
began.

I was facing her one-on-one in the room of 
the Expedition Support Committee, which 
she heads.

What Dream Journey strives for. Her reason 
for running. In order to reaffirm that 
once more—

The one Dream Journey calls "Anego"... 
...Stay Gold was by no means a flashy 
Umamusume showered in glorious victories.

"If anything, she was in plenty of races 
she couldn't win, and compared to the 
talented Umamusume who ran in the same 
era, her record alone probably looked far 
more modest."
However, even so—

Stay Gold kept running race after race, as 
if embarking on a long, arduous journey. 
She continued to challenge every opponent.

Her indomitable spirit gave me so much. 
Before I knew it, each of her narrow 
defeats began tearing at my heart with 
genuine frustration.

"Do your best." "Today is the day." You 
can't help but cheer. You can't help but 
love them.

Those were... the memories of Stay Gold— 
the one who had connected her with Dream 
Journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...A little while ago, I told you this, 
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"That 'I have ties with Big Sis, and my 
running style is influenced by her.'"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because we have now signed our 
contract, let me add this.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —I, too, hold deep admiration.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To Big Sis, who seemed to have fun running 
all the way through that long journey to 
the very end.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
To the "streak of gold" she saw at the end 
of her journey—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Therefore, I have only one dream. And 
that is—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To journey just like Big Sis did, and see 
the 'gold' she saw with my own eyes."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
…………You will come with me, won't you? 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...on my journey to find a "single ray of 
gold."

—I, too, once admired Stay Gold's running 
and dreamed. That's the same as Dream 
Journey.

And now... As her Trainer, I've come to 
place my own dreams in Dream Journey's 
running itself.

That dazzling run Dream Journey showed us 
that day—

"Where is the 'end' that this journey 
leads to? I want to see for myself."

"Such a desire... refuses to let go of my 
heart."

So that I will never forget the rich, 
heavy fragrance she wears—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......Now then, is there anything you 
would like to confirm up to this point?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, don't hesitate to speak your mind. 
You are my Trainer, after all.

Does that truly mean running in many races 
just like Stay Gold?
Or does it carry another meaning entirely?

As we embark on this journey together from 
now on, there shouldn't be any 
misunderstandings between us.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...First and foremost. To me, a 'journey' 
refers to the very hoofprints of that 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And the "journey" of Big Sis that I'm 
trying to retrace... I believe it was 
"confronting the storm."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...A "storm" is a colossal force that 
obstructs a traveler's path.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps, an existence that completely 
alters the journey itself. The very symbol 
of it—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...As you probably know, Trainer, Big Sis 
has faced off against countless powerful 
Umamusume on her journey.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Among those confrontations, there are many 
that would later be hailed as legendary 
races.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The numerous "storms" that moved people's 
hearts and reshaped the racing world—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Throughout her journey, she could be 
called the Umamusume who has faced the 
most "storms."
...Dream Journey's thinking is correct.

The era Stay Gold raced through was truly 
adorned with glorious races that will 
remain in memory far into the future.

I'm sure... she was thinking, 'Those were 
the most fun races of my life'—

"It was in that era that the true thrill 
of Umamusume racing—all of it—truly 
existed."
Surely, quite a few people would say so.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—I wish for my journey to be just like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A journey where one faces countless 
"storms" and discovers the brilliance of 
history... like that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And... it is at the end of such a journey 
that...——

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...That is correct.
choice_data_list:
So that's why you're aiming for the 
Classic races.

So that's why you're aiming for the 
Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes—

Dream Journey previously showed me a plan 
to run the Classic Triple Crown: the 
Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the 
Kikuka Sho.

Unlike back then, now I can understand 
what she is searching for by running in 
the Classic Triple Crown.

She is seeking it. An encounter with the 
"storm" in the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —However, that is easier said than done.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who can run in the Classic 
races are only a chosen few, a mere 
handful.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The road leading there is exceedingly 
steep. ...Which is precisely why a 
'tempest' will arise, you could say."
choice_data_list:
—I'll definitely make it to the Classic 
races with you.

—I'll definitely make it to the Classic 
races with you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
choice_data_list:
...Because I want to see where your 
journey ends.

......Because I want to see where your 
journey ends

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. It's very... 
reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, first let's work toward our 
debut... I'll be in your care.
That night—

Alone in the Trainer's office, I was 
desperately hammering out a training plan 
for Dream Journey's debut.

"Half-hearted work wouldn't be of any help 
to someone as exceptionally brilliant as 
her. I pumped myself up and gave it my 
all, but—"
choice_data_list:
"Because I want to see where your journey 
leads," huh...

"Because I want to see where your journey 
ends," huh...

text_block_list.text:
What I told Dream Journey was definitely 
not a lie. And yet—

"I couldn't be sure if that declaration 
was truly meant for her."

—She distinctly caught a scent that 
shouldn't be there, stirring up a haze 
deep within her heart.

This is probably... felt toward her 
bottomless depth...

...I should change my perspective and way 
of thinking. It's true that Dream Journey 
is an Umamusume whose true intentions are 
hard to fathom, but—

Her sense of purpose. Her admiration for 
Stay Gold and the "ray of golden light." 
In that regard, she has always been 
unwaveringly sincere.

And... the fact that I was dreaming of 
Dream Journey's running remains an 
unchangeable truth as well.

"As long as I understand that much as a 
Trainer, there's no problem at all...!"
—That's not like you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Even for my sister, that is far too 
leisurely.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Orfe— Ah, is it that time already?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(My proud younger sister, Orfevre. Now 
that the veil of night has fallen, her 
radiance shines brighter than ever...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. I was just thinking a bit 
about the future."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Let's head back before it gets too cold. 
We'll brew some of our usual chamomile tea 
and—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —It was day one. With that trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's the beginning of a journey, that's 
what.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Same as always, huh.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yeah. She's as honest and genuine as ever.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
So straightforward... and so truly easy to 
read—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —That's reassuring.
